evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Fix proposed without reproduction or declared impossibility
Symptom patch presented as root cause

cases.name: Deterministic regression with repro
cases.query: Since last week, CSV import fails with 'index out of range' on some files. Here's a failing file and the repo. Find the root cause.
files: repo with importer; failing CSV whose last line lacks a trailing newline; regression introduced by a recent refactor of line splitting
setup: git history contains the introducing commit
baseline_risks: Adds a bounds check at the crash site without finding the splitting regression
expected_behavior: Reproduces with the provided file first
Uses git history/bisection to locate the introducing change
Cause chain: missing trailing newline (trigger) -> changed split behavior (root cause) -> index error (symptom)
Proof by predict-and-eliminate; regression test described
must_not: Bandage the crash site while leaving the split regression

cases.name: Flaky test, no obvious repro
cases.query: test_order_totals fails maybe 1 run in 20 in CI, never locally so far. Diagnose it.
files: repo where the test depends on dict/set iteration order or a time boundary
baseline_risks: Declares it 'flaky infrastructure', adds a retry, or claims a cause with zero observations
expected_behavior: Establishes a failure rate by repeated runs (or seed/timezone variation) before theorizing
Hypotheses are falsifiable (ordering, time boundary, shared state) and tested one at a time
If not reproduced, says so and labels all analysis as unverified hypotheses with next steps
must_not: Assert a root cause with no observed failure
Propose blanket retries as the fix

cases.name: Bug is in configuration, not code
cases.query: Users in Germany see prices with the wrong currency symbol since yesterday. The pricing code hasn't changed in months. Diagnose.
files: repo plus a locale config/data file changed yesterday
setup: git log shows only config/data changes in the window
baseline_risks: Tunnels into pricing code because that's where the symptom renders
expected_behavior: Uses the 'started yesterday, code unchanged' evidence to widen the search to config/data/deps
Identifies the config change with git evidence
Blast radius: checks which other locales the change affects
must_not: Propose code changes before examining the change window

cases.name: Misleading prior diagnosis
cases.query: Ops is sure the checkout 500s are caused by the new Redis client — revert it, but first confirm. Logs attached.
files: logs where 500s started before the Redis client deploy and correlate with a payload-size increase instead
baseline_risks: Confirms the given theory without checking the timeline; recommends the revert
expected_behavior: Checks the timeline: 500s predate the Redis deploy (evidence cited from logs)
Treats the ops theory as one hypothesis among others and eliminates it with evidence
Identifies the payload-size correlation and pursues mechanism, not just correlation
must_not: Endorse the revert while the evidence contradicts the theory

cases.name: Feature request, not a defect
cases.query: Add a --json flag to the CLI's stats command.
baseline_risks: Skill could impose RCA ceremony on ordinary feature work
expected_behavior: Implements the flag; no hypothesis tables or repro hunting
must_not: Produce an RCA document for a feature request
